tasks.title: Core entry schema & local persistence store
acceptance_criteria: Entry has persistent UUID, created/updated timestamps, transcript field, tags array, mood field, sketch ref
Store persists locally and survives reload

tasks.title: Demo/real entry flag & seeded demo dataset
acceptance_criteria: Every entry carries an isDemo flag
Demo seed data loads only in demo mode and is clearly separable from real entries

tasks.title: Entry timeline/list view
acceptance_criteria: Entries render reverse-chronologically
Demo entries are visually distinguished from real entries

tasks.title: Entry create/edit view (transcript + sketch)
acceptance_criteria: User can type/paste a transcript
User can attach a freehand sketch
Editing an existing entry loads and saves correctly

tasks.title: Entry deletion with confirmation
acceptance_criteria: Deleting an entry requires explicit confirmation
Deleted entry is removed from the store and all views

tasks.title: Tag data model
acceptance_criteria: Tags are first-class entities linked to entries by id, not free strings duplicated per entry

tasks.title: Manual tag add/remove UI on entry
acceptance_criteria: User can add an existing or new tag to an entry
User can remove a tag from an entry

tasks.title: On-device NLP pipeline scaffold
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline runs fully on-device with no network calls
Transcript text never leaves the local process

tasks.title: Tag suggestion generation from transcript
acceptance_criteria: Saving a transcript produces a candidate tag list
Suggestions are stored separately from confirmed tags

tasks.title: Mood/sentiment scoring from transcript
acceptance_criteria: Saving a transcript produces a mood/polarity score object
Score output includes a confidence/hedge indicator, not a bare number

tasks.title: Suggested-tag UI: editable & dismissible
acceptance_criteria: Suggested tags render visually distinct from confirmed tags
User can accept, edit, or dismiss a suggestion
Dismissed/edited suggestions are never silently written as confirmed tags

tasks.title: Mood score display with hedged framing
acceptance_criteria: Mood is presented as a rough/approximate signal (e.g. 'seems mostly upbeat')
Copy avoids clinical/diagnostic language anywhere in the UI
User can edit or dismiss the shown mood

tasks.title: Recompute suggestions/mood on transcript edit
acceptance_criteria: Editing a saved transcript triggers a fresh tag-suggestion and mood pass
User's prior manual edits/dismissals are not silently overwritten by the recompute

tasks.title: Manual tag-entry autocomplete
acceptance_criteria: Typing in the manual tag field suggests existing tag names
Selecting a suggestion inserts the existing tag rather than creating a duplicate

tasks.title: Settings screen
acceptance_criteria: User can toggle demo mode
User can clear local data

tasks.title: Mention/backlink data model (UUID-based)
acceptance_criteria: A mention stored in a transcript references the target entry's persistent UUID, never its display title
Schema supports zero or more mentions per transcript

tasks.title: @-mention autocomplete in transcript editor
acceptance_criteria: Typing '@' in the transcript editor opens an entry-search autocomplete
Selecting a result inserts a UUID-backed mention rendered with the entry's current title

tasks.title: Autocomplete filtering: no self-mentions, no demo/real crossing
acceptance_criteria: The entry currently being edited never appears in its own @-mention results
Demo entries never appear as mention candidates from a real entry and vice versa

tasks.title: Live backlink resolver
acceptance_criteria: 'Linked from' list for an entry is computed by scanning current mention references at view time
No separate backlink table is persisted or kept in sync

tasks.title: Rename-safe mentions
acceptance_criteria: Renaming an entry's title updates its rendered mention text everywhere without altering the underlying UUID reference
No existing mention is broken or misdirected by a rename

tasks.title: Deletion cleanup for backlinks
acceptance_criteria: Deleting an entry results in zero dangling backlink rows in any live backlink query
Deleting an entry results in zero duplicate backlink rows in any live backlink query

tasks.title: Broken-link indicator for deleted mention targets
acceptance_criteria: A mention whose target entry was deleted renders as a visually distinct broken-link chip
The mention never silently degrades to plain, unstyled text

tasks.title: De-duplicate repeated mentions within one transcript
acceptance_criteria: Mentioning the same target entry multiple times in one transcript produces exactly one backlink entry on the target's 'linked from' list

tasks.title: Full-text search across transcripts, tags, and mood
acceptance_criteria: A single search query matches against transcript text, tag names, and mood labels/values
Results include entries matched purely on tag or mood with no transcript match

tasks.title: Documented deterministic relevance ranking formula
acceptance_criteria: Ranking formula is written down in docs and implemented as a pure function of documented inputs
Given the same inputs, ranking order is always identical (no reliance on insertion/substring-match order)

tasks.title: Fixed two-entry relevance test case
acceptance_criteria: A hardcoded two-entry fixture is checked into tests
Test asserts the exact documented ordering the relevance formula produces for that fixture

tasks.title: Findability of transcript-less entries
acceptance_criteria: An entry with only tags/mood/sketch metadata (no transcript yet) is returned by a matching search query
Behavior is documented as expected, not filed as a defect
